cache_control_vs_dontneed.answer: CONTROL and DONTNEED are compared as separate fresh-corpus branches.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: kernel reclaim completion is not directly observed

cache_mmap_dontneed.answer: mmap plus DONTNEED is classified from the returned result or exact error.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: mmap residency and kernel reclaim behavior

cache_o_direct.answer: O_DIRECT support or bypass is an observed capability/error outcome only.

causal_model.answer: The raw record supports associations between requested configuration and measured walls, not unobserved causality.

cold_process_curve.answer: Cold process observations retain startup/full-process timing and coordinated read throughput separately.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: process startup attribution depends on returned timing fields

cold_thread_curve.answer: Cold thread rates use bytes divided by the enclosing coordinated wall.

fastsafetensors_cpu_source_only.answer: fastsafetensors is capability/source-only evidence; geometry opacity is explicit.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: API may not expose block geometry

fuse_backpressure.answer: Backpressure is classified only from raw samples.

fuse_syscall_latency.answer: Per-worker syscall latencies are preserved without merging FUSE values into authoritative cohorts.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: per-worker syscall boundaries and scheduler attribution

fuse_visibility.answer: FUSE visibility is diagnostic, not a throughput claim.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: FUSE connection-to-mount mapping may be unavailable

hot_best_candidates.answer: Best thread, best process, and the one-worker reference are selected only after an all-valid meaningful smoke curve.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: best-candidate selection is smoke-derived unless confirmation exists

hot_process_scaling.answer: Process scaling retains startup and full-process timing when returned by the remote reader.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: process creation outside the timed read

hot_speedups.answer: Speedups use median aggregate bytes / coordinated wall relative to the one-worker reference.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: speedup is relative to retained observations, not worker-rate sums

hot_threads_scaling.answer: Thread scaling is reported only from enclosing coordinated read walls.

instanttensor_capability.answer: InstantTensor is probed for capability and CPU rejection only.

mount_options.answer: Mount options are quoted from raw FUSE diagnostics when present.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: mount options are remote diagnostic output; host mount policy remains opaque

sequential_advice.answer: Advice is compared only as fresh before/after observations.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: advice effect is not a causal kernel proof

twelve_worker_headroom.answer: A 12-worker observation is retained only when the bounded gate admits it.
unsupported_or_opaque_layers: 12-worker branch is conditional on a material 4-to-8 smoke improvement
